hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook for phiEth/ETH pools that implements 1:1 swaps between ETH and phiEth by intercepting beforeSwap, directly depositing/withdrawing through the phiEth contract, and returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass concentrated liquidity. Liquidity addition is blocked; only ETH/phiEth pairs with zero fee are permitted.
